scientific_integrity: The near-free numerical characterization and the intended abstract A7 configuration are acknowledged as prior; exact algebra and analytic arguments establish the stronger parameter stratification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the displayed one-parameter smooth-four-conic family; the t=-1 singular-conic fiber is excluded. Possible unindexed errata are a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Singularity strata and the unique nearly-free member of an explicit four-conic family
